title: Reply to Facebook and Instagram messages
blurb: Answer Messenger and Instagram DMs without opening the apps.

steps.title: Find social messages
steps.body: Click the filter icon above the chat list and filter by last message channel to see only Facebook or Instagram chats.

steps.title: Open the chat
steps.body: Click the conversation. The DM shows in the timeline with a Facebook or Instagram icon.

steps.title: Pick the right channel
steps.body: In the channel switcher, choose **Facebook** or **Instagram** so your reply goes back to the same place.

steps.title: Reply within 24 hours
steps.body: Type and send your reply. Meta only lets businesses reply to a DM within 24 hours of the customer's last message, so answer these first.
steps.tip: No social messages coming in? Your Page needs connecting first. See **Connect your social accounts** in the Guide.
